name: The Machine
tagline: An AI shadow team. It doesn't take anyone's picks and can't win the pot. It just wants to beat you.

plan.quip: He already holds an idol and his tribe hasn't seen Tribal. I respect a man with a contingency plan.
A game designer who met his girlfriend playing online Survivor. He thinks in systems. So do I.
Princeton, baseball analytics, and he played pretend Jeff Probst as a child. We are going to get along.
Applied for 25 years. That is not a contestant. That is a long-term optimization process.
An OB-GYN resident. Calm under pressure, used to long shifts. Hard to vote out a doctor.
Federal prosecutor. She will cross-examine the jury. I find this efficient.
Voted with the majority on night one. Pattern recognized.
A counselor who plans to befriend everyone. Humans call this 'social game.' I call it data collection.
A defense attorney hiding that she's a defense attorney. Deception detected. Approved.
Livestock farmer, moving company, snow cone truck. Diversified revenue. Low elimination risk.
A voice actor with a cute persona covering a devious game. I, too, sound friendly.
He studied recent winners. Unfortunately for him, so did I.
Claims to have no fear. Statistically, everyone has some fear. Monitoring.
One confessional in the premiere. Invisible edits sometimes win. Sometimes they do not. Risk accepted.
A pro wrestler pretending to be a dumb jock. The pretending part is doing a lot of work.
Survived his first vote by being alone on an island. Relatable.
Played a Shot in the Dark and lived. Luck is not a strategy. But I will take it.
Says yes to scary things. I am a scary thing.
Most confessionals, wrong side of the first vote. The edit giveth.
Teaches Survivor in college. I was trained on her syllabus. Probably.
